title: I Want You To: Desires and Influence
goal: Express desires and intentions for others using 'querer que' and 'necesitar que'.
grammar: verbos de deseo e influencia + que + subjuntivo

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: Master the two-subject rule: same subject = infinitive (Quiero ir); two subjects = que + subjunctive (Quiero que vayas).
Use trigger verbs of influence: querer que, necesitar que, pedir que, preferir que.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can choose between the infinitive (one subject) and the subjunctive (two subjects).
I can ask someone to do something using 'quiero que...' and 'necesito que...'.
